note: Reviews deliberately closed without a public reply. derive.py removes these from the triage queue so they stop accruing SLA age, and reports them separately so a decision never looks like an oversight. THIS FILE IS PUBLIC: use the reason codes below and never free text about a reviewer.

reason_codes.no_content: Rating only, or too little text to respond to meaningfully.
reason_codes.pre_opening: Predates public opening; describes a building that wasn't finished.
reason_codes.not_a_visit: Does not describe a visit to the Library.
reason_codes.duplicate: Same visitor, already answered on another platform.
reason_codes.answered_elsewhere: Covered by a reply to a near-identical review.
